characters.summary: Spider-Man enhanced by the alien symbiote, granting him heightened aggression, amplified physical strength, and autonomous tendril manipulation. He fights with increased brutality compared to his standard suit.
limitations: Vulnerability to sonic frequencies and intense heat
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the standard Stark or integrated suits with the alien symbiote, boosting physical strength and aggressive tendencies while inheriting traditional symbiote vulnerabilities like sound and fire.

sources.supports: General abilities and symbiote characteristics in Marvel media

unknowns: Exact canonical cinematic feats of the standalone symbiote suit within the primary MCU timeline prior to its brief appearance in No Way Home's post-credits scene.

characters.summary: Sprite is an Eternal who specializes in illusion casting, creating highly realistic holographic projections to deceive opponents in combat. Physically, she possesses the baseline superhuman durability and strength of an Eternal.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to having her illusions seen through by those aware of her nature
Physical vulnerability relative to heavy cosmic hitters
limitations: Cannot physically alter reality, only project realistic illusions.

sources.supports: Sprite abilities, Eternal physiology, and illusion casting.

feats.claim: Created massive illusions of cities and battles to deceive enemies.

unknowns: Full offensive capability beyond deception and illusion projection.

characters.summary: Star-Lord relies on advanced alien weaponry, rocket boots for aerial maneuverability, and unpredictable tactical ingenuity. He frequently employs energy blasters, gravity mines, and various gadgets.
weaknesses: Human baseline physical durability without protective gear
limitations: Relies heavily on technological gear which can be damaged or confiscated.

sources.supports: Star-Lord equipment, weapons, and combat style.

feats.claim: Briefly held an Infinity Stone with assistance from the Guardians.

notableResults.note: Defeated using the power of an Infinity Stone shared with teammates.

campaignTags.claim: Uses jet boots for flight and maneuverability
Utilizes gravity mines, taser elements, and energy blasters
Pilots the Milano and other spacecraft

unknowns: Loss of Celestial genetic power after Ego's destruction.

characters.summary: Stick is a blind master martial former leader of the Chaste. Despite his blindness, his heightened senses allow him to fight highly skilled superhuman opponents with weaponized canes and blades.
weaknesses: Human physical vulnerability to lethal trauma
Sensory overload vulnerabilities common to heightened-sense martial artists
limitations: Completely blind, relying entirely on non-visual senses.

sources.supports: Stick background, combat skills, and heightened senses.

feats.claim: Trained Matt Murdock and Elektra Natchios in advanced martial arts.

unknowns: Upper limit of his capabilities against heavily armored meta-humans.

characters.summary: Taserface is a Ravager mutineer who relies on brute force, energy rifles, and standard mercenary weaponry. He commands subordinates and engages enemies with aggressive, direct combat tactics.

sources.supports: Taserface equipment and affiliation with the Ravagers.

feats.claim: Led a mutiny against Yondu Udonta taking control of his faction.

unknowns: Exact durability limits of his specialized chest plating.

characters.summary: Taskmaster possesses photographic reflex technology that allows her to instantly mimic the fighting styles, martial arts, and weapon techniques of any opponent she observes.

mechanisms: Anticipating attacks via fighting style analysis

weaknesses: Dependent on visual input to learn and mimic styles
Mind control via the Red Room chemical override
limitations: Subject to chemical programming by external handlers prior to being freed.

feats.claim: Replicated the fighting techniques of Black Widow, Hawkeye, and Black Panther upon observation.

notableResults.note: Fought multiple times before the chemical control was neutralized.

campaignTags.claim: Uses multi-functional weapons like bows, swords, and a shield

unknowns: Full combat adaptation limits against completely chaotic or non-human combat styles.

characters.summary: Thanos is a colossal Titan warlord possessing immense physical strength, near-invulnerability, and master-level tactical intellect. He fights using brutal hand-to-hand combat and a double-bladed sword.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to extremely powerful cosmic or magical artifacts
limitations: Lacks innate magical or energy projection powers without external items like the Infinity Stones.

sources.supports: Thanos physical traits, combat abilities, and history.

feats.claim: Overpowered Hulk in hand-to-hand combat without using stones.

notableResults.note: Defeated Hulk purely through martial dominance.
Overcame Tony Stark's advanced nanotech armor.

unknowns: Exact biological limits of Titan longevity and resistance to energy attacks.

characters.summary: Thanos empowered by the Heart of the Universe, granting him absolute omnipotence over reality, time, and space within his continuity context.
weaknesses: Not established within standard cinematic continuity
limitations: None established in this empowered state
characters.formDifferences: Elevates base Thanos to omnipotence, granting limitless control over the fabric of reality.

sources.supports: Thanos base profile reference (Heart of the Universe is primarily a comic artifact, adapted here as requested form).

unknowns: Direct MCU feature implementation, as the Heart of the Universe is primarily a Marvel Comics construct rather than a standard MCU artifact.

characters.summary: Thanos equipped with the Infinity Gauntlet housing all six Infinity Stones, granting complete mastery over reality, time, space, mind, soul, and power.
weaknesses: Severe physical feedback and radiation damage upon snapping
Vulnerable during the brief gesture required to close the fist
limitations: Emits lethal gamma radiation that permanently damages the user's body upon activation.
characters.formDifferences: Adds the Infinity Gauntlet to Thanos, providing cosmic omnipotence across all six foundational domains of existence.

sources.supports: Capabilities of the Infinity Gauntlet and its stones in the MCU.

notableResults.note: Successfully executed the Snap eradicating half of all life in the universe.

unknowns: Whether a non-Titan biological entity could survive wearing the complete gauntlet without immediate disintegration.

characters.summary: An older, hardened alternate future version of Thanos who has successfully conquered nearly all existence, commanding cosmic forces and wielding lethal execution techniques.
weaknesses: Arrogance derived from absolute victory in his timeline
limitations: Subject to standard mortal limits of an aged Titan.
characters.formDifferences: Represents an older, battle-hardened future variant of Thanos with expanded conquest experience.
unknowns: Exact cinematic feats of King Thanos distinct from main continuity Thanos within live-action films.
